result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with no stock, so WH-1 shows only "Bolt 10" in your example. The stock tests pass offline, including a new regression test.

- **Fix:** `listStockByWarehouse` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 1485) had no quantity filter. I added `AND s.quantity > 0` to its WHERE clause, matching the other overview queries.
- **Test:** `warehouseStockOmitsProductsWithNothingLeft` in `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java` sets nuts to 0 in WH-1, then checks the list is just bolts and that the nut quantity still answers 0.

I ran `StockOverviewTest`, `StockTest`, `StockAdjustmentTest`, `StockPerCategoryTest` and `SlowMovingStockTest`. The per-product quantity lookup is a separate query, so it is unchanged. Nothing is committed.
